page.overview:
Who is Augustine?

Augustine is a character who is a member of Cobra in the movie Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins. He was ordered to hunt down and kill Snake Eyes’ father. Snake Eyes dedicated his life to avenging his father and killing Augustine.

Cobra ordered Augustine to find and kill Snake Eyes’ father. Augustine tracked him down to a G.I. Joe safe house and forced him to roll a pair of rigged dice. Once the Joe agent rolled double ones (snake eyes), Augustine murdered him. Twenty years later, Cobra betrayed Augustine and traded him for the Jewel of the Sun. Snake Eyes spared Augustine when he learned the truth, and chose to save the Arashikage Clan from Kenta's attack.
